Trask wedding canapés.d: Poached and chilled on thick cucumber rounds with Russian dressing and dill. Six to an order.

Wall Street crab cakes.d: A pair, bound with egg, mayonnaise, Dijon, parsley and crumbs, browned in butter. Lemon and tartar sauce.

Power lunch steak salad.d: Seared hard and carved thin over romaine, cherry tomatoes, red onion and crumbled blue cheese. Red wine vinaigrette.
Power lunch steak salad.note: Table 7, K. Parker. Bill to Petty Marsh.

Wedding cake slice.d: Butter sponge split and spread with raspberry jam under Swiss meringue buttercream. Cut tall.
